draft_text: Asterion outperformed RuneSpan on Meridian-QA, while Darsen and Ko reported that Patchwise Replay improves exact-match accuracy on the same benchmark.
revised_text: Asterion achieved higher exact-match accuracy than RuneSpan on Meridian-QA (80.4% vs 78.0%), though no statistical test was reported for this comparison; Darsen and Ko (2023) describe applying Patchwise Replay by revisiting high-loss training passages, but do not report its effect on exact-match accuracy on this benchmark.
rationale: Asterion (80.4) numerically exceeds RuneSpan (78.0) on Meridian-QA, but no statistical test is reported for this comparison, so "outperformed" overstates. The P1 passage describes applying Patchwise Replay but does not report that it improves exact-match accuracy on Meridian-QA, so that attribution is unsupported.
